versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the AI Readiness File Generator.
- Generates a complete set of 18 AI readiness files for any website from a single command.
- Includes automated research phase with 10+ targeted web searches to ensure accuracy.
- Adapts output based on site type (SaaS, E-commerce, Education, etc.) for industry relevance.
- Outputs all files in a folder named after the domain, ready to deploy to the web root.
- Provides a concise summary and a link to the generated files upon completion.
